claims.claim: A used dry pressing iron that is still working is available for sale.
claims.evidence: The witness only reports appearance (white electric iron, cord/plug looks worn/dirty, visible dirt/scuffing). No test of heating/temperature or controls is shown.

risks.risk: Not actually working (no proof it heats, reaches temperature, or the thermostat functions).
risks.proof: A short clip of the iron switched on showing it heats (e.g., temperature indicator/steam-less heating behavior) and then ironing a fabric strip.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested until a heating test is shown.

risks.risk: Electrical safety issue at the plug/cord (worn/dirty near connection could indicate damage or poor contact).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the plug pins and cord strain relief plus a quick wiggle test while powered (showing no flicker/sparking) or a continuity test reading.
risks.if_unproven: Price at a lower level due to potential cord/plug fault risk.

risks.risk: Soleplate condition may be poor (dirt/scuffing/marks could mean scratches/pitting that reduce ironing quality).
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the soleplate surface in good light showing whether it is smooth or scratched/pitted, plus a pass on fabric to show glide.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically worn with possible reduced performance.

risks.risk: Dry pressing claim may be wrong (could have steam features that are faulty, or steam holes clogged/leaking).
risks.proof: Photo/clip of the steam holes area and a test run showing whether any steam leaks or drips occur when used as dry.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: steam system unknown/fault risk, treated as dry-only with possible issues.

risks.risk: Controls/thermostat may be faulty (even if it powers on, it may not regulate temperature).
risks.proof: Clip showing temperature setting changes (e.g., dial positions) and corresponding heating behavior on a thermometer or by ironing at different settings.

proof_requests: Show a power-on test: iron heats up and reaches temperature (ideally with a thermometer or clear indicator) and then iron a small fabric piece.
Provide close-up photos of the plug and the full cord (including strain relief) to confirm no internal breaks/damage.
Provide a clear close-up of the soleplate surface (steam holes area too) in good light to assess scratches/pitting.
Show the thermostat/control operation (dial changes) and confirm it maintains temperature during use.
If it has any water/steam parts: show the water tank area and confirm no leaks/drips during a short run.
response.reason: The item type is identifiable as an electric dry pressing iron, so it can be priced at its worst-case based on visible wear and the lack of any heating/working test evidence.
